Chapter 342 - 342 Watch The Experiment; Mission Completed!

Chapter 342 - 342 Watch the Experiment; Mission Completed!

342 Watch the Experiment; Mission Completed!

The middle-aged man with gold-rimmed glasses was Professor Wu Tian.

Wu Tian had a deep impression of Lin Fan. It could even be said that he admired Lin Fan.

A professor worshiping a student?

That was right!

Lin Fan solved several difficult math problems, invented the earthquake prediction device, super batteries, and so on.

In Wu Tian’s eyes, Lin Fan was almost omnipotent.

Therefore, when the biomedicine project encountered an unsolvable problem, he immediately thought of Lin Fan.

That was why Zheng Qian went to ask Hu Tian for help today.

Since others were friendly to him, Lin Fan naturally would not put on airs.

“You must be Professor Wu Tian, right?”

“There’s no professor in front of you,” Wu Tian hurriedly said. “You can just call me Old Wu.”

The three graduate students who were focused on their experiments heard their conversation and stopped what they were doing. They looked at Lin Fan curiously.

Almost everyone at Jiangbei University knew the name Lin Fan.

However, Lin Fan did not accept interviews.

Hence, there were very few people who knew what he looked like.

Suddenly being stared at by so many people, Lin Fan felt a little uncomfortable.

He coughed lightly and said, “Old… Wu…Forget it, I’ll just call you Professor Wu.

“Professor Wu, can I watch you complete an experiment?”

Wu Tian did not hesitate at all and said directly, “The three of you, complete the experiment once. Remember, you must do it well!”

The three graduate students nodded vigorously. Then, they took a deep breath and started the experiment from the beginning with a more careful and focused expression.

They looked like soldiers who were about to be inspected.

This kind of biological experiment was very difficult to see with the naked eye.

Wu Tian pointed at the computer screen and said, “Lin Fan, please look here…”

The cells that were usually invisible were densely packed on the three screens.

In the beginning, the cells in the three screens were slowly wriggling in the solution.

However, as time passed, the cells squirmed slower and slower.

In the end, some of the cells were completely silent.

At this moment, the three graduate students injected three different liquids.

The cells on the first screen resumed squirming but soon stopped moving.

The cells on the other screen seemed to have gone crazy. They squirmed rapidly, but they stopped at an even faster speed.

The cells on the last screen did not respond at all.

…

Immediately after, red, blue, and yellow curves appeared on the screen.

The one-hour-long experiment ended.

Professor Wu Tian asked in an expectant tone, “Student Lin Fan, what do you think? How should I improve it?”

In fact, not only was Wu Tian looking forward to it, but Professor Zheng and the three graduate students were also looking forward to it.

Lin Fan did not reply immediately.

Instead, he placed his attention on the system mission

[Mission: Watch a biological experiment (1/1), read ‘Introduction to Insulins’, ‘Treatment of Diabetics’, ‘Pharmaceutics and Pharmaceutics’, ‘Pharmaceutics Technology’, and ‘Microbiology and Immunity Technology’ (0/5). You’ll be rewarded with Professor-Level Biology Experience, human islet recovery medicine, its manufacturing principle, and a complete thesis.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan let out a satisfied look and said, “I’ll go to the library first.”

After saying that, he turned around and left, ignoring Wu Tian, Zheng Qian, and the others who were still in a daze.

After the heavy rain, the air in the library was filled with a sweet smell, making the library even more crowded than usual.

If an ordinary person came to the library, they would be like a drop of water merging into the sea. They would not be discovered at all.

However, Lin Fan was like a dazzling sun. As soon as he walked into the library, someone immediately came over to greet him.

“You’re here,” a female student said with a smile.

She was Lu Ling, whom Lin Fan had met several times in the library.

Today, Lu Ling was wearing a long blue dress and a pair of white shoes. She was like the blue sky and white clouds, looking very fresh.

Lin Fan smiled and nodded. “Yes.”

“What books are you looking for this time?” Lu Ling asked. “Let me help you.”

Lin Fan did not stand on ceremony. He said directly, “Introduction to Insulins, Treatment of Diabetics, Pharmaceutics and Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutics Technology, and Microbiology and Immunity Technology.”

“Is that the field of biomedicine? Over there.” Lu Ling nodded and walked toward the bookshelf on the left.

Soon, a large row of books on biomedicine appeared in front of them.

Obviously, she was very familiar with the entire library.

With Lu Ling’s help, they found the five books in a short while.

Then, Lu Ling led Lin Fan to the place where they usually sat.

Lin Fan did not waste time chatting. He picked up a book and started flipping through it.

For two minutes, the sound of a book being flipped could be heard. A book that was a hundred pages thick had been read from the beginning to the end.

Then, the second book, the third book…

Ten minutes later, he finally closed the last book.

At this point, he had finished reading all five books.

At this moment, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Mission completed. Watch a biological experiment (1/1), read Introduction to Insulins, Treatment of Diabetics, Pharmaceutics and Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutics Technology, and Microbiology and Immunity Technology (5/5). You’ll be rewarded with Professor-Level Biological Experience, human islet recovery medicine, its manufacturing principle, and a complete thesis.]

Instantly, Lin Fan’s mind was filled with a lot of knowledge about living things, especially about islets.

Lin Fan was not too surprised by this result. He just quietly accepted this knowledge.

Lu Ling saw that Lin Fan had finished reading all the books and could not help but ask, “Are you planning to study biology?”

She had seen Lin Fan quickly flip through books on different subjects several times. Every time he finished flipping through, he would solve a problem not long after… Or he would invent something that shocked the world.

Therefore, Lu Ling no longer naively thought that Lin Fan was just flipping through books for fun.

Lin Fan said, “I’ve already finished researching.”

“Huh?” Lu Ling blinked her big eyes, her pretty face full of confusion.

Lin Fan did not continue to explain. He looked down at the questions on the table and asked, “Are there any questions you don’t know?”

However, Lin Fan seemed to have helped her solve some questions every time she saw him.

It seemed to be true.

Lu Ling’s pretty face turned slightly red, and she said in a soft voice, “Yes.”

Having just completed his mission, Lin Fan was in a pretty good mood.

He picked up a pen and paper and wrote down the answers to the questions in front of him in an ingenious and detailed way.
